issues.description: Public method name mismatch for the farm-song operation: the problem statement and the template declare and ask students to implement a public method named singFarmSong() (problem_statement.md and template src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java). The solution implementation, however, exposes a public method named playFarmSong() (solution src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) while no public singFarmSong() is provided in the solution. This naming inconsistency between the expected API (singFarmSong) and the solution's public API (playFarmSong) can confuse students and break automated checks or example usages that call singFarmSong().
issues.suggestedFix: Align the public API names across artifacts. Rename the solution's public method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong(), or add a public singFarmSong() in the solution that delegates to playFarmSong(). Ensure the public method signature and visibility exactly match the template/problem statement so students and automated tests target the same method name.
